# BarGraph

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Group of aligned bars on a shared scale with per-bar alarm levels (IND-102).

![BarGraph, light theme](../img/widgets/bar-graph-light.png#only-light){ width="248" }
![BarGraph, dark theme](../img/widgets/bar-graph-dark.png#only-dark){ width="248" }

**Compact indicators** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.BarGraph) ·
schema [`bargraph.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.BarGraph(
    value=[62, 64.5, 58, 83.1],
    label="BarGraph",
    bars=[
        {"label": "Z1", "normal_lo": 55, "normal_hi": 70},
        {"label": "Z2", "normal_lo": 55, "normal_hi": 70},
        {"label": "Z3", "normal_lo": 55, "normal_hi": 70},
        {"label": "Z4", "normal_lo": 55, "normal_hi": 70, "hi": 80, "hihi": 90},
    ],
    unit="°C",
    size=(240, 160),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[260,160]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | array of any | `[]` | host | One value per bar. |
| `bars` | array of any | `[]` | host | Bars: a label, or {label, normal_lo, normal_hi, lolo, lo, hi, hihi}; only label is required, missing limits are null. |
| `min` | number | `0` | host | Lower end of the shared scale. |
| `max` | number | `100` | host | Upper end of the shared scale. |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host |  |
| `format` | string | `"%.1f"` | host |  |
| `deadband` | number | `0` | host | Hysteresis of the bar alarm levels (ALARM-003). |
| `alarm_levels` | array of enum | `[]` | derived | Alarm level of each bar (a bar without a value is normal). Derived: by the host when it owns the state, otherwise by the front end (HOST-004). |
